units: <cite ref="Niddah 47b:51">Nidd. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>מחמת בריאותֵה</he> (or read … <he>תא</he>) on account of (his) obesity.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 45b:4">Bekh. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ אתחלא וכ׳</he> it is (unusual) strength which happened to rest in the left hand (and left-handedness is therefore no defect), opp. <cite ref="K00461"><he>כחישותא</he></cite> weakness.
